title: Vanadium-doped cobalt selenide: an efficient bifunctional electrocatalyst for overall water splitting
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01766H, Paper
Ankita Sahu, Manisha Sadangi, J. N. Behera
Vanadium-doped CoSe2 i.e. V@CoSe2-1 is a potent bifunctional electrocatalyst for overall water-splitting, requiring a cell voltage of 1.96 V to deliver the current density of 10 mA cm−2 in alkaline medium.
